recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native portrait-first arcade lane-runner called **Pastel Quest: Vibes Cottage Arcade**. Preserve the source loop: player starts a run, drags/taps vertically to snap between lanes, objects scroll from right to left with accelerating speed, GOOD objects award feedback while BAD objects end the run, score displays as a timecode, and restart returns to the same loop.

Interpret the world from this prompt: Arcade. A satirical game inspired by Zelda built around platformer play, with creative, puzzle, satisfying energy, anti anxiety session design, search-friendly hooks like platformer, platformer, arcade, aesthetics like pastel dream, soft girl aesthetic, cottagecore, and meme-tone cues such as vibes, its giving. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The player is a tiny green-capped cottage hero. GOOD objects are Heart Keys. BAD objects are Doom Chores. The background is a procedural pastel dream cottage field with soft hills, flowers, clouds, hearts, and adventure-quest satire. The HUD uses cozy meme copy but remains clear on mobile.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: single-screen canvas arcade lane-runner / score attack
- objective: survive an accelerating right-to-left stream, collect beneficial objects, avoid harmful objects, and push the timecode score higher.
- input model: one-thumb pointer/touch drag or tap maps vertical position to one of four default lanes; start/restart are explicit click/tap CTAs.
- core loop: start -> accelerate scroll -> randomly spawn GOOD/BAD blocks -> move player smoothly toward chosen lane -> collide with objects -> update score/feedback -> fail on bad collision -> restart.
- fail/friction state: BAD collision stops the run, hides HUD, shows final timecode and restart button.

## Protected mechanics
- Four-lane default lane geometry and config-driven lane count.
- Vertical lane selection using pointer/touch y-coordinate.
- Acceleration formula, currentSpeed based on baseSpeed * sqrt(multiplier), random spawn probability, and horizontal movement.
- Collision test, GOOD bonus/particles, BAD game-over transition, score display format, and restart flow.

## Remixed target
Pastel Quest: Vibes Cottage Arcade preserves the lane-runner mechanics while reframing them as a soft satirical adventure-platformer lane quest. A tiny green-capped cottage hero collects Heart Keys, dodges Doom Chores, and travels through an animated pastel dream field with cottagecore props, meme-tone HUD language, compact feedback GIFs, and mobile-first one-thumb readability.
